name: rich-text
description: Rich text as a tree of typed nodes. Page code sets the link schemes and first heading level. To mark top-level blocks, page code must give the current fill revision. A new or refused fill clears the marks and makes the old revision stale. A policy change keeps both if the fill is still valid.
